# VG Don Services — Accounting & Bookkeeping

> VG Don Services is a London-based UK Chartered Accountancy practice run by Danuka Geekiyanage Don (ACA, BFP, ICAEW member), offering fixed-fee bookkeeping, VAT, year-end accounts, self-assessment tax returns, business startup advice and general tax advice for freelancers, sole traders, landlords and small businesses. Chartered Accountant expertise at freelance rates.

## Key facts

- Founder: Danuka Geekiyanage Don
- Qualifications: ACA (Associate Chartered Accountant), BFP, ICAEW member
- Location: London, UK (in-person London; remote UK-wide)
- Services: Bookkeeping & VAT, Year-End Accounts, Self-Assessment Returns, Business Startup Advice, Tax Advice
- Pricing: Fixed fee, agreed upfront, no hourly billing
- Contact: vgdonservices@gmail.com | +44 7460 855128
- VAT registration threshold (UK): £90,000 (unchanged since 1 April 2024)
- MTD for ITSA: 6 April 2026 (>£50k) | April 2027 (>£30k) | April 2028 (>£20k)
